purpose: Development-set test of whether a simplified Stage-1 task (no evidence ids, timestamps, quality checks, confidence, normalization; compact output) improves Qwen3-0.6B extraction versus P02
ids_source: EXP_004 evaluation/P02_comprehensive_extraction_dev50/run_manifest.json (identical to split_v1.json prompt_dev_ids; checked at start)
runtime: openvino_genai.LLMPipeline, FP16 IR (EXP_002/models/Qwen3-0.6B-ov-fp16), fresh pipeline per encounter
max_new_tokens_note: unchanged from P02; the cap is not the cause of any difference (P02 outputs never hit it) and is kept to leave generation settings identical
transcript_rendering: unchanged existing renderer (segment id, speaker id, role, times, text); the S1 prompt tells the model to ignore ids and times
differences_from_P02: compiled-model cache directory inside EXP_006 (no effect on numerics)
evaluator: unchanged canonical evaluator (evaluation_runner.score_encounter / aggregate), strict headline, applied to adapter output (S1) and stored parsed output (P02)
comparison_baseline: stored P02 outputs (not re-run); reproduced by the evaluator at 153/522/1707 TP/FP/FN before inference
